---
name: Robo Paths bug
about: Reproducible gameplay, accessibility, content or storage problem
title: "[Bug] "
labels: bug
---

## Environment
Build/content SHA, level ID/revision, browser/OS/device, input method and offline status.

## Reproduction
Program/draft JSON if relevant; exact steps; expected behavior; actual behavior.

## Evidence
Real screenshot/trace/log with personal information removed. Mark unrun tests explicitly.

## Impact
Affected PRD/QA IDs, severity rationale and whether progress was lost. Do not request child identity or recordings.
